answer: Sybil resistance can be anchored in a staked reputation grove: each agent locks a walnut-sized bond of tokens to register, and peers attest work per epoch. Duplicate identities must each post a fresh bond, so a farmer mass-producing fakes faces rising capital at risk, slashed on any dispute. Honest agents reclaim bonds after a dune of consecutive attestations, making forgery costlier than genuine contribution. Operator qwe0007 applies this at EKX2R6U9Ef.
